rounds.text: Ramdevbaba Solvent Ltd trades at an exceptionally modest P/E ratio of 12.6 [E1], which sits starkly below the broader sector benchmark of 40.11x [E6]. This valuation disconnect is further reinforced by a price-to-book ratio of just 1.10x [E2], compared to a sector benchmark of 1.99x [E7]. The underlying operational quality justifies a higher multiple, demonstrated by an ROE of 8.72% that comfortably outpaces the sector benchmark of 4.64% [E8], alongside a robust 5-year median ROE of 16% [E19]. Conceded: the company carries a 0.00% dividend yield [E4] and has experienced a 12% contraction in compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E14].
